execution.completion.note: Complete on return: nothing is left outstanding, as for mpi_comm_rank.

execution.gpu_scope.note: Per-thread: each calling thread asks about itself or its own team, independently of the others.

execution.launch.note: Callable on the host and inside target regions: LLVM 20.1.7's device runtime implements the thread-team inquiries for the device (llvm-project tag llvmorg-20.1.7, offload/DeviceRTL/include/Interface.h declares all three; offload/DeviceRTL/src/State.cpp defines them). omp.h is the same header for host and device compilation and cannot say so, which is why Heuristic Classification left launch null.

execution.locality.note: Reads only the calling thread's own team state.

execution.runs_on.note: Executes wherever it is called -- on the host, or on the device inside a target region.

execution.thread_safety.note: These routines exist to be called concurrently by every thread of a team (the answer differs per caller), so they place no restriction on concurrent callers.

identity.since.note: One of the thread-team inquiry routines the runtime library has had since the first OpenMP specifications (Fortran 1.0, 1997; C/C++ 1.0, 1998). Neither omp.h nor the 5.2 specification carries a per-routine version marker.
